purpose: Pre-screen candidates against production VBR (ENCODER-RATE-CONTROL-DEFAULTS.md section 3.3). Each is production argv for its base mode plus appended options; no B-frames (hardware reorder is a per-family proof owned by VOD-BFRAMES-TIMELINE-DESIGN.md).

listed: -preset <int> (from 0 to 7) (default 0): veryfast 7, faster 6, fast 5, medium 4, slow 3, slower 2, veryslow 1
-look_ahead <boolean> Use VBR algorithm with look ahead (default false)
-look_ahead_depth <int> Depth of look ahead in number frames (from 0 to 100) (default 0)
options_confirmed.generic: -global_quality is the generic AVCodecContext option production qvbr already sets

observed_at_verbose.look_ahead: RateControlMethod: LA; LookAheadDepth: 20 (MaxKbps is not reported: LA bitrate control has no peak bound)

candidates.name: preset-slower
candidates.why: More analysis per frame at the same bitrate (driver default is medium, TargetUsage 4).

candidates.name: look-ahead-20
candidates.why: Look-ahead rate control moves bits to hard frames; 20 frames is under one 2 s segment at 24 fps.

candidates.name: look-ahead-40
candidates.why: The same at a deeper window; delays the first segment more.

candidates.name: qvbr-18
candidates.why: Constant quality below the failed 22: tests whether quality, not bytes, can clear the hard-fixture path.

candidates.name: qvbr-26
candidates.why: Constant quality above 22: tests whether the bytes path can clear without a VMAF loss.
